rows.reason: Panic-free workspace lint refactor of vize_atelier_dom SFC selector (full workspace Clippy): unchecked slice/index/expect sites become checked access (get/let-else/iterators) at the same reachable offsets, plus lint attributes. No reachable input changes compiled output.

Changes only the croquis virtual-TS generator helper types (__RuntimePropCtor/__RuntimePropValue) emitted for the type checker, plus a docs workflow step. The virtual TS is never part of compile_sfc/compile_template output.

Fixes croquis TypeResolver::extract_properties so `=>` inside a union member does not close a nesting level, keeping nested union members out of template prop bindings for the type checker. TypeResolver is not used by any vize_atelier_* crate.

Croquis marks type/interface exports that use `typeof <setup value>` as not hoisted, and Canon's virtual TS keeps them inside `__setup`. TypeExport.hoisted is read only by Canon's virtual TS generator; atelier_sfc does not consume type_exports.

Canon's batch virtual project now re-exports named exports from split-script .vue modules, and Croquis::merge_plain_script keeps the regular <script>'s NonScriptSetup scope for virtual TS. compile_sfc reads bindings, not the merged scope chain, so compiled output cannot differ; the change only feeds `vize check`.

Panic-free workspace lint refactor of vize_atelier_sfc CSS and Vite plugin helpers: unchecked slice/index/expect sites become checked access (get/let-else/iterators) at the same reachable offsets, plus lint attributes. No reachable input changes compiled output.

Fixes Croquis strip_js_comments (byte-wise copying mangled non-ASCII literals once a comment was stripped) and Canon reserved-prop rewriting. strip_js_comments only feeds Canon virtual TS and Croquis identifier extraction (identifier names, not literal bytes); no compiler crate emits its output, so compiled code cannot differ.

Builds Croquis effect-graph summaries (cycle counting, summary merging, split <script>/<script setup> effect graphs) that feed only the effect-cycle lint rule. No compiler entry consumes the effect graph, so compiled output cannot differ.
Compares unused-binding names by string slice instead of by reference to the same CompactString; identical results, and only Patina reads these facts.

Croquis now records the declaration offset of each v-for alias (and stops re-adding duplicate SetupConst bindings at offset 0) so Patina reports unused v-for aliases at the alias span. Declaration offsets feed only lint diagnostics; the template compiler does not read Croquis v-for scope offsets.

vize check CLI plumbing: sharded corsa CLI execution, tsconfig extends inlining, slot-prop annotations and const-generic stripping in canon virtual TS, and const-modifier stripping in croquis declaration (.d.ts) emit. None of these feed compile_sfc or the template compilers.

The fix registers heritage for non-exported interfaces and type aliases in the Croquis script parser and gives each heritage clause its own cycle set in TypeResolver. Those types are read by Canon virtual TS (template props scope) and analysis only; compile_sfc resolves defineProps through ScriptCompileContext, so compiled output cannot differ.
Test and build-script restoration only: the Vapor upstream parity test harness and vize_vitrine's build script. No compiler source changed.

The fix replaces a byte-slice in vize_canon's virtual TS generator (is_use_template_ref_binding) with a checked `get`, so type-checker virtual TS generation no longer panics on multibyte script comments. The croquis change is a test only; no compiler (atelier) code changed, so compiled output cannot differ.

Panic-free workspace lint refactor of vize_atelier_sfc script analysis and compile_script: unchecked slice/index/expect sites become checked access (get/let-else/iterators) at the same reachable offsets, plus lint attributes. No reachable input changes compiled output.

Only the Croquis virtual-TS preamble type `__WithDefaultsResult` changed (Omit & mapped -? type -> Omit & Required<Pick<...>>) plus type-checker snapshots. That text is emitted only into Canon's virtual TypeScript for type checking; compile_sfc/compile_template never emit it.

Changes only how an unrecognised value of the DOM lane selection environment flag maps to a lane (it now selects the legacy lane); the flag itself was removed by 99db931e54. Default compiled output for every input is unchanged.

clone_expression now flattens a Compound expression to a Simple one carrying its source. Compound expression nodes are only built in unit tests; the parser and transforms hand process_inline_handler Simple nodes, so no public input reaches the changed arm and output cannot differ.

Changes the Croquis template drawer so v-if expressions stay in the incoming scope and element attrs sit outside v-slot props. This only moves scope ids, undefined-ref reports and semantic-snapshot data used by the linter and the Canon virtual TypeScript (the only fixture change is a check snapshot); template codegen does its own scoping and is unaffected.

The change fills defineModel type/required/default metadata in vize_croquis::script_parser and feeds it into Canon's virtual TypeScript props/emits. compile_sfc builds its own defineModel props/emits (vize_atelier_sfc script/define_model_metadata.rs) and never reads these Croquis fields, so compiled output cannot differ; this is type-checker-only analysis.
Changes only the Croquis virtual-TS template generator (typed v-for alias emission) and a Patina type-aware test. Virtual TS feeds the type checker/linter only; compiled render output is untouched.
Croquis Drawer keeps per-occurrence provenance for mixed static/runtime directive names and Croquis-CF fallthrough reporting uses it. Cross-file analysis only; no compiler crate consumes it.

Replaces a checked_sub().expect() in the type-resolution batch guard Drop with a debug_assert plus saturating_sub, and adds #[deny(let_underscore_drop)] to the NAPI batch call sites. The guard is only created by the batch APIs; a single compile_sfc never opens a batch, and the counter cannot underflow through the public guard, so compiled output is byte-identical.

Reduces reactivity-loss false positives: croquis plain-value/destructure origin tracking, croquis_cf reactivity and lifecycle-cleanup diagnostics, Patina no-reactivity-loss rule and canon checks. This is linter/type-checker analysis only; no binding types or compiler inputs change.

Panic-free workspace lint refactor of vize_atelier_vapor: unchecked slice/index/expect sites become checked access (get/let-else/iterators) at the same reachable offsets, plus lint attributes. No reachable input changes compiled output.

Croquis Drawer now resolves `<component :is="X" @kebab-event>` listeners to the bound component so Canon can infer the payload type. Template analysis for the type checker only; no compiler crate consumes it.

Croquis script parser now records real declaration offsets for reactive sources and distinguishes ShallowRef/ShallowReactive kinds. The compiler only consults ReactiveKind via needs_value_access (true for Ref and ShallowRef alike) and readonly checks (unchanged), and binding types are unchanged, so compiled output cannot differ.
Benchmark tooling only: the davinci_production_perf example's digest encoding and backend-selection report. Examples are not part of any compile entry; no compiler source changed.
Stable-toolchain borrow fix: descriptor script text is borrowed through as_ref() instead of the unstable as_str() on Cow. The same bytes reach the same functions; compiled output is unchanged.

Croquis's script parser now records top-level static object literals and expands `...spread` entries inside runtime defineProps/defineEmits objects into prop/emit definitions and bindings. Croquis ScriptParseResult macros feed Canon virtual TS and Patina; the SFC compiler builds props/emits/bindings from its own ScriptCompileContext and runtime_object_literals is read nowhere else.

Cross-file provide/inject analysis (vize_croquis_cf) now resolves slot-projected children against the component that writes them, used by `vize lint --cross-file`. The vize_croquis visit_element change only memoizes element_subtree_end; scope bounds are identical, so no compiled output changes.

Croquis plain-script parsing registers exported value declarations as bindings, and the undefined-binding analysis reports the expression offset. Both feed only the Canon type checker and the linter; compile_sfc collects normal-script bindings with its own collector and parses only script setup through Croquis, whose path is unchanged.

The fix teaches the Croquis TypeResolver (types.rs, types/props.rs, script_parser/result.rs) to follow interface heritage such as Pick<BaseProps, "required"> when listing props. Only Canon virtual TS and analysis read that resolver; the SFC compiler resolves defineProps types through its own ScriptCompileContext and never calls TypeResolver, so compiled output cannot differ.

Vite/Nuxt request classification now treats `.vue.tsx` virtual ids like `.vue.ts` (request.rs, npm plugin resolve/virtual helpers). This is module-id routing in the bundler plugin; compile_sfc output for a given SFC is unchanged.
Marks LegacyDialectCapabilities #[non_exhaustive] and bumps workspace/npm versions to 0.205.0. An API-compatibility attribute and version strings cannot change compiled output.
Croquis reactivity-loss detection ignores value-sink calls (emit, Number, console.*, JSON.stringify, Math.*). Reactivity losses feed only Patina/Canon diagnostics; the compiler does not read them.

Changes vize_canon virtual TS generation, the `vize check` Nuxt command and croquis runtime-prop type extraction (extract_props_from_runtime), which at this commit fed only the type checker/linter (compile_sfc used its own ScriptCompileContext for props codegen). Corsa/LSP session overlays, `vize check`/`vize fmt` CLI plumbing, Maestro virtual-code and completion work, and test scratch paths. The only atelier_sfc edits move test scratch directories; no compiler source changed.

The fix changes only the Croquis template drawer (drawer/template/directives/v_on.rs), which decides when a v-on expression opens an implicit event-handler scope for analysis. That scope feeds Canon virtual TS and the linter; compile_sfc and the template compilers never consult it, so compiled output cannot differ.

The compiler's runtime `emits` codegen comes from its own ScriptCompileContext and did not read croquis emit definitions, so compiled output cannot differ.

Croquis's drawer keeps a parent-component stack so a `<template #name>` slot host records its owning component in VSlotScopeData, letting Canon type the slot props from that component's $slots instead of `any`. Only the Croquis scope data read by Canon virtual TS changes; compiled output cannot differ.

Croquis now keeps each template identifier's root offset (extract_identifier_refs_oxc) so undefined-reference diagnostics point at the real occurrence (`name` in `user.name + name`) instead of the first substring match. UndefinedRef offsets feed only Canon/Patina diagnostics; the template and SFC compilers never read them.

Changes only croquis cross-file component resolution (is_builtin_component now normalizes kebab-case names), which feeds cross-file lint diagnostics (UnregisteredComponent). The compiler does not use the cross-file analyzer, so compiled output cannot differ.

Canon virtual-TS fixes (generic template refs, interface-extends props, legacy Vue 2 template refs) plus Croquis ScriptParseResult un-hoisting type exports whose names are imported and a TypeDefinitions::has_interface_extends helper. `type_exports`/`hoisted` are read only by Canon and Croquis declaration TS, never by the SFC compiler, so compiled output cannot differ.

Croquis records argument-less object-form v-on (`v-on="{ ... }"`) as a VOn template expression instead of synthesizing an event handler, so Canon's virtual TS emits `void ({ ... }); // VOn`. Template expressions feed only the type checker and linter; DOM/SSR/Vapor codegen does not consume them.

Lets the Croquis drawer and Canon virtual TypeScript resolve <component :is="ns.Member" @event> to the static member component so listener payloads are typed. Only the type checker consumes the component-event target; compiled output does not change.

Croquis now records whether a v-slot argument is dynamic (ScopeChain::dynamic_v_slot_scopes) so Canon's virtual TS types `v-slot:[name]` props from the union of all declared slots instead of a static slot key. The Drawer template analyzer is not on the compile_sfc / compile_template path (the compiler tracks v-for scopes itself), so compiled output cannot differ.

Adds Options API prop bindings to the Croquis virtual TypeScript so Patina type-aware lint types Vue 2 options props in templates. Virtual TS only feeds the type-aware linter/type checker; compile_sfc does not use it.

The only compiler-crate change normalizes interface heritage text in the Croquis script parser's TypeResolver registration (script_parser/result.rs); everything else is Canon virtual TS and its snapshots. TypeResolver feeds Canon and analysis only, not compile_sfc or the template compilers, so compiled output cannot differ.

Maestro virtual code now exports semantic script bindings, and Croquis identifier extraction takes the OXC path for non-ASCII expressions. Both are IDE/analysis paths; the compiler does not call Croquis extract_identifiers_oxc, so compiled output cannot differ.

Rewrites vize_croquis ImportResolver::extract_type_definitions from regex scanning to an OXC AST walk. Canon's virtual TS now types template props declared through withDefaults as default-resolved (Required<Pick<...>>), changing only the generated virtual TypeScript and its snapshots. No vize_atelier_* code changed, so compiled output cannot differ.
